svg.title: Session (tp::session): one run as the game plays it, the binding layer's interface

g.text: Session (tp::session): one run as the game plays it, the binding layer's interface
the frame time decides only how many 1 ms steps run, never their length;
no heap after create(); a pull-off is a new session on sled::heavier();
with a parking, the session plays the whole turn (turn_sequence)
or the pull alone at the line
